page_title: MON 1-2 ATA | Monza v Atalanta 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Valentin Carboni (Monza) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Warren Bondo (Monza). Antonio Giua doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+3' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Giua ignores the protests.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

89' 1 - 2 Goal! Daniel Maldini (Monza) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Marco Carnesecchi had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
87' The ratio of the ball possession is 56:44.
83' Today's referee Antonio Giua rightly decides to book Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) for his harsh tackle.
83' This shall not pass! Alessio Zerbin (Monza) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
78' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Armando Izzo will be replaced by Luca Caldirola (Monza).
78' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) replacing Roberto Gagliardini.
78' The substitution has been made. Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) has replaced Milan Djuric.
77' The total number of attempts is 12:12.
73' 0 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Ademola Lookman finds El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the top right corner. 0:2.
69' A clever short pass gives Matteo Pessina (Monza) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
68' The substitution is prepared. Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rafael Toloi.
68' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) replaces Ederson.
67' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' Armando Izzo (Monza) sees a yellow card from Antonio Giua after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Daniel Maldini (Monza) coming on for Georgios Kyriakopoulos.
64' Here is a change. Charles De Ketelaere is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta).
61' The game is interrupted now, Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
57' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
56' Isak Hien (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Giua saw the whole situation. Monza have a free kick.
55' Good movement by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

55' What a chance that is! Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
54' Substitution. Andrea Colpani is replaced by Valentin Carboni (Monza).
53' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
51' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
51' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) prepares to take a corner kick.

51' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Michele Di Gregorio thwarts him and the score remains the same. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
50' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Atalanta win a corner.
49' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will take a corner kick.
49' The corner kick from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
46' Substitution. Mitchel Bakker makes his way off the pitch and Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) comes on as his replacement.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Milan Djuric (Monza) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

45+2' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' 0 - 1 Goal! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner from Ademola Lookman. His well-placed header ends up in the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 0:1.
44' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
41' The resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is cleared.
41' Michele Di Gregorio is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), pushing the ball around the post to safety. Atalanta will take a corner kick.
40' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
38' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' A snap shot by Alessio Zerbin (Monza) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi produces a good save to thwart him.
33' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
31' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
29' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
28' Problems for Gian Piero Gasperini as Emil Holm is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) replaces him.
27' Emil Holm (Atalanta) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
24' Emil Holm (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
22' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

21' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
20' The resulting set piece from Monza is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
15' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
13' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
12' Andrea Colpani (Monza) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
11' Dangerous play by Ederson (Atalanta). Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Matteo Pessina (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.

9' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

8' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Michele Di Gregorio makes a great save to stop the effort going into the left side of the goal.
7' Milan Djuric (Monza) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
3' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Antonio Giua pulls out a yellow card.
3' PENALTY APPEAL after Samuele Birindelli (Monza) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
2' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
2' Monza quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua will referee today's match.
